indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX activity_events_correlation_idx ON public.activity_events USING btree (correlation_id, occurred_at) WHERE (correlation_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_external_idx ON public.activity_events USING btree (occurred_at DESC) WHERE (actor_kind = 'external'::text)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_job_idx ON public.activity_events USING btree (job_id, occurred_at) WHERE (job_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_office_time_idx ON public.activity_events USING btree (office_id, occurred_at DESC, activity_id DESC)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_project_time_idx ON public.activity_events USING btree (project_id, occurred_at DESC) WHERE (project_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX activity_events_user_time_idx ON public.activity_events USING btree (office_id, occurred_at DESC, activity_id DESC) WHERE (visibility = 'user'::text)
CREATE INDEX activity_write_failures_office_time_idx ON public.activity_write_failures USING btree (office_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX artifacts_pending ON public.artifacts USING btree (state) WHERE (state = 'generating'::text)
CREATE INDEX browser_sessions_live ON public.browser_sessions USING btree (project_id) WHERE ((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (expired_at IS NULL))
CREATE INDEX calendar_event_projects_project ON public.calendar_event_projects USING btree (project_id)
CREATE INDEX contact_labels_office_idx ON public.contact_labels USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX decisions_search ON public.decisions USING gin (search)
CREATE INDEX documents_tags_idx ON public.documents USING gin (tags)
CREATE INDEX drive_watch_due ON public.drive_watch USING btree (last_checked_at)
CREATE INDEX event_triggers_office_idx ON public.event_triggers USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX events_reversible_idx ON public.events USING btree (occurred_at DESC) WHERE reversible
CREATE INDEX failure_signatures_office_idx ON public.failure_signatures USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX inbound_commands_slack_by_channel ON public.inbound_commands_slack USING btree (channel_id)
CREATE INDEX lessons_by_kind ON public.lessons USING btree (job_kind) WHERE (job_kind IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX mail_messages_search ON public.mail_messages USING gin (search)
CREATE INDEX mcp_auth_codes_office_idx ON public.mcp_auth_codes USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX mcp_providers_office_idx ON public.mcp_providers USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX notebook_exclusions_office_idx ON public.notebook_exclusions USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX notebook_sync_queue_pending ON public.notebook_sync_queue USING btree (created_at) WHERE (state = 'pending'::notebook_sync_state)
CREATE INDEX notebook_sync_queue_uncertain ON public.notebook_sync_queue USING btree (uncertain_since) WHERE (state = 'uncertain'::notebook_sync_state)
CREATE INDEX outputs_pending_review ON public.outputs USING btree (created_at) WHERE ((reviewer_status = 'pending'::reviewer_status) AND (NOT deterministic))
CREATE INDEX preference_proposals_office_idx ON public.preference_proposals USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX preference_proposals_open ON public.preference_proposals USING btree (proposed_at DESC) WHERE (state = 'open'::proposal_state)
CREATE INDEX project_events_to_sync ON public.project_events USING btree (office_id) WHERE (sync_state = 'pending'::text)
CREATE INDEX projects_name_trgm ON public.projects USING gin (app.normalise_name(name) gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX provider_models_stale_idx ON public.provider_models USING btree (last_probed_at NULLS FIRST)
CREATE INDEX slack_app_credentials_office_idx ON public.slack_app_credentials USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX standing_authorizations_office_idx ON public.standing_authorizations USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX suggestions_by_weight ON public.suggestions USING btree (weight DESC, raised_at DESC) WHERE (state = 'open'::text)
CREATE INDEX task_calendar_links_pushed ON public.task_calendar_links USING btree (pushed_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX task_tombstones_office_idx ON public.task_tombstones USING btree (office_id)
CREATE INDEX tasks_mine_remind ON public.tasks USING btree (remind_at) WHERE (assigned_to_human AND (remind_at IS NOT NULL) AND (state <> 'done'::text))
CREATE INDEX workspace_layouts_office_idx ON public.workspace_layouts USING btree (office_id)
